encoding: byte strings and scalars are lowercase hex; scalars are 32-byte big-endian
layout: each vector has the inputs in given and the values to compute in expected; *_failure vectors have no expected, the call must fail

valid.comment: smallest e: e = 1, so E = G
largest e: e = n - 1, so E = -G

encaps_valid.comment: largest valid ek: each 3-byte group packs q - 1 next to q - 2, rho is all 0xff

implicit_rejection.comment: first valid vector with the first bit of c flipped
first valid vector with a bit in the last byte of c flipped
first valid vector with E replaced by another valid point, 3*G
first valid vector with E taken from the second valid vector
second valid vector decapsulated by the first recipient

decaps_failure.comment: E_bytes: x = p + 1, which must not be reduced to the valid x = 1
E_bytes: x not on the curve

encaps_failure.comment: ek: coefficient 0 = q (first half of a 3-byte group)
ek: coefficient 1 = q (second half of a 3-byte group)
B: x = p + 1, which must not be reduced to the valid x = 1
B: x not on the curve
e: n + 1, which must not be reduced to e = 1
